summary.intent: Smoke-test the first-run (new-user) flow of the callisto CLI and fix the rough edges found, including the init output polish (item 3), E121 (item 4) and snapshot --tag validation (item 5).
summary.outcome: E121 could not be reproduced and was dropped. The init output was polished with a new test assertion, and snapshot --tag now validates up front with a new E324 diagnostic, test, docs and spec criterion. Two changesets were added, full CI was run after formatting, and a PR was committed, pushed and opened.

repo: Work happens in a git worktree at .claude/worktrees/smoke-main of the callisto repo; scratch scripts and PR bodies go in /tmp/claude-501/.
The Rust workspace has crates callisto-cli (commands/init.rs, init/tests.rs) and callisto-graph (commands/snapshot.rs, error.rs).
New error codes need three updates: the error definition in callisto-graph/src/error.rs, a row in docs/errors.md, and a spec criterion in docs/specs/cli.json.
User-visible changes need one changeset per topic (two here), and full CI must pass before opening a PR.
Full CI includes a formatting check, so run the formatter and then re-run CI.
Init stdout assertions can be added to the existing init unit tests in crates/callisto-cli/src/commands/init/tests.rs.

code.finding: plan_snapshot did not validate --tag. A bad tag surfaced as 'internal error' (E038) and an empty tag silently produced version 0.0.0--sha. Validation now happens up front and returns the new GraphError E324. The test module needed a GraphError import.
The top of the init output (header text before the detected summary and config body) was polished, and a stdout assertion was added in init/tests.rs.

workflow: Try to reproduce reported issues in a real new-user flow with a smoke script before fixing, and drop items that do not reproduce (E121 showed a clean E267 instead).
Probe the current behavior with a throwaway script before changing code, to confirm the bug.
Search for tests and docs that reference old text before changing user-facing strings.

friction: E121 could not be reproduced in the new-user flow.
Finding the init config printer and the existing stdout-asserting tests took many grep and read calls.
The new snapshot test failed to compile at first because of a missing GraphError import in the test module.
The first full CI run needed a formatting pass and a re-run.
open_items: E121 (item 4) was dropped as unreproducible; revisit if it is reported again with a concrete repro.
The Files Modified list omits snapshot.rs and init/tests.rs, so check that the PR includes every edited file.
